author: TeIq
content:
PR 8 closed WITHOUT IMPLEMENTATION. Q1 from #143 (resolved on the epic-Q-resolution sub) selected option A — structured config only. The structured-only V2Body shape (flat / per_category / per_subject_class / time_decay) covers all stated operator use cases per the design's analysis.

The DSL / JSON-Logic path adds substantial complexity (custom parser, sandboxing, fuzzing, mandatory boost-attack protection per Q6-C) without a concrete operator demand justifying it.

If operator demand emerges in the future, reopen this issue with the specific use case the structured shape can't express. The parser-bug surface this would expose (per the issue body's "highest-risk component" framing) means proceeding only with a concrete need is the right move.

Per architect skill / recalibrate: explicit conditional-no-op closure documenting the design-time decision is the cleanest outcome.
